## In Class Activity
```{r loading data 1}
load("~/ECO 411/data/mort_21.RData")
```

```{r scatterplot}
mort_plot <- ggplot(data = mort_2021, 
                    aes(y = years_ed, x = age_years)) +
                    geom_point() +
                    ylab("Year of Education") + 
                    xlab("Age (In Years)")
mort_plot
```

### Loading Data
```{r}
#when we have a file already in Rdata format
load("mort_2021.RData")

#slightly more complicated is RDS format
#we need to store this as an object
mort_2021 <- readRDS("mort_2021.rds")

#this is the command for STATA data
mort_2021 <- haven::read_dta("mort_2021.dta")

#excel - this requires the readxl package
#install.packages("readxl")
library(readxl)
mort_2021 <- read_excel("mort_2021.xlsx", sheet=1,col_names=TRUE)

#csv - easy
mort_2021 <- read.csv("mort_2021.csv")
```

### Working With The Data
```{r}
glimpse(mort_2021) #Viewing the Data

mort_2021 <- mort_2021 %>% #Creating Dummy Variables
  mutate(female = ifelse(sex == "F", 1, 0))
table(mort_2021$female)

mort_2021 <- mort_2021 %>% #Cleaning More Variables
  mutate(
    years_ed = case_when(
      educ2003 == 1 ~ 8,
      educ2003 == 2 ~ 10,
      educ2003 == 3 ~ 12,
      educ2003 == 4 ~ 13,
      educ2003 == 5 ~ 14,
      educ2003 == 6 ~ 16,
      educ2003 == 7 ~ 18,
      educ2003 == 8 ~ 21,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    age_years = case_when(
      age == 1999 ~ NA_real_,
      age < 2000  ~ as.numeric(age - 1000),
      TRUE        ~ 0
    ),
    marital_status = case_when(
      marstat == "D" ~ "Divorced",
      marstat == "M" ~ "Married",
      marstat == "S" ~ "Single",
      marstat == "U" ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE           ~ "Widowed"
    ),
    manner_of_death = case_when(
      mandeath == 1 ~ "Accident",
      mandeath == 2 ~ "Suicide",
      mandeath == 3 ~ "Homicide",
      mandeath == 7 ~ "Natural",
      TRUE          ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    hispanic_eth = case_when(
      hispanic >= 200 & hispanic <= 299 ~ 1,
      hispanic > 900                    ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE                               ~ 0
    ),
    race = case_when(
      race40 == 1                     ~ "White",
      race40 == 2                     ~ "Black",
      race40 == 3                     ~ "AIAN",
      race40 >= 4 & race40 <= 14      ~ "AAPI",
      TRUE                             ~ "Multiple Races"
    )
  )

```

```{r filtering & summarizing & grouping}
#When filtering data use the filter() command

mort_wcda <- mort_2021 %>%
  filter(female == 1 & years_ed >= 16 & monthdth == 8)

head(mort_wcda)

#To summarize use summarize()
mort_2021 %>%
  filter(is.na(years_ed)==FALSE) %>%
  summarise(avg_ed = mean(years_ed))

#To group data use the group_by() function
mort_2021 %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  filter(is.na(years_ed)==FALSE) %>%
  summarise(avg_ed = mean(years_ed))

#To select specific data use select()
mort_asyr <- mort_2021 %>%
  select(age_years,sex,years_ed,race,X)
head(mort_asyr)
```
